description: Create an Apple Icon Composer .icon bundle from a foreground image and background color. Outputs a ready-to-use .icon bundle for Xcode 26.

blur_material.description: Liquid Glass blur amount (0-1, omit to disable)

dark_bg_color.description: Dark mode background color as hex

foreground_path.description: Absolute path to foreground image (PNG or SVG)

glyph_scale.description: Scale of foreground glyph (0.1-2.0, default 1.0 fills ~65% of icon area in Icon Composer)

output_dir.description: Directory to write the .icon bundle to

split_layers.description: Split multi-shape SVGs into separate glass layers (each shape gets independent glass effects)

name: create_icon
